experiment_name: Case H: Noisy Screenshot OCR Evaluation
fixture_provenance: Synthetic low-contrast image fixture simulating scanned transaction screenshot

outcome.empirical_finding: Contrast enhancement improved calculated CER from 0.20 to 0.10 by resolving 'O' -> '0', but 'I' -> '1' remained ambiguous. Downstream systems must preserve token uncertainty rather than falsely asserting an intentional transaction ID mismatch.
